description: This file defines an interface for client-side monitoring events within the AWS SDK for PHP. It declares methods for retrieving, prepending, and appending monitoring events.
external_files: php (standard language library, no explicit external file references)
external_methods: None explicitly referenced, the interface only declares methods.

classes.name: MonitoringEventsInterface
classes.description: Interface for adding and retrieving client-side monitoring events

methods.name: getMonitoringEvents
methods.description: Get client-side monitoring events attached to this object. Each event is represented as an associative array within the returned array.

methods.name: prependMonitoringEvent
methods.description: Prepend a client-side monitoring event to this object's event list.

methods.name: appendMonitoringEvent
methods.description: Append a client-side monitoring event to this object's event list.
